annotation.summary_en: A woman places a specific dating ad in a newspaper, only for the one man who meets her requirements to visit her just to say he is not interested.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch begins in a newspaper office where a middle-aged woman, played by a male comedian in drag, sits across from a fast-talking, bespectacled clerk in a yellow shirt. She wants to place a dating advertisement. The clerk enthusiastically upsells the reach of the paper, claiming millions of readers across Armenia. The woman lists four strict conditions for her suitor: he must be 30 years old, very tall, have light chestnut hair, and most importantly, he must not be a drinker. After paying 10,000 dram, she leaves, and the scene shifts to her apartment. Dressed in a floral outfit and holding a red telephone, she excitedly tells her friend 'Mar' that the ad is published and suitors could arrive at any moment. Soon, there is a knock at the door. A man matching her description perfectly—tall, light-haired, and sober—appears holding a large cellophane-wrapped bouquet. However, instead of proposing a date, he delivers the punchline: he only came to tell her not to count on him, leaving the woman in tears.
catchphrases: Ընկերուհի ջան, ես եկել եմ ձեզ ասեմ, որ իմ վրա հույս չդնեք
